facts.fact: Vero 亲手做的最丑黑骷髅蛋糕，Kayla 爱它
facts.anchor: It is objectively the ugliest cake I have ever seen in my life, and I love it so much

facts.fact: Aaron 案结案：无证据关联她与岛，警方认定他逃了
facts.anchor: The case with Aaron is now closed. There was no evidence tying him to me or the island, and the cops believe he skipped town

facts.fact: 生日追逐夜：Kayla 要回被 Aaron 事件吓软的「疯狂粗糙男人们」
facts.anchor: I want my crazy, rough men back

facts.fact: 包场之夜岛屿异常安静，琥珀灯光与黑迷宫让她既兴奋又不安
facts.anchor: I’m not used to there being no activity at all

facts.fact: 疯人院走廊里她与自己的蜡像对视，发誓它动过
facts.anchor: It’s freaky watching myself stare back at me

facts.fact: 红雾墓园：她深呼吸稳住自己，门响时不再逃跑
facts.anchor: I won’t let him win. Breathing deeply, I compose myself, and when the gate creaks, I don’t run

facts.fact: 墓上夺回之夜后 Kayla 宣告：我拿回了控制权
终章宣言：红旗男人们归我，谁也别想再从我手中夺走任何东西
facts.anchor: They are mine, and no one is taking anything from me again
